name: financial-services
one_liner: A ready-made set of AI assistants that draft investment-banking pitch decks, equity research notes, and financial reconciliations for a human to review before anything goes out.
buyer: A boutique investment bank or independent wealth-management firm that can't afford a large analyst team but needs research memos and pitch materials drafted fast.
business_use_cases: A boutique M&A advisory firm uses the Pitch Agent to draft first-pass comps and pitch decks overnight, so junior bankers start from a draft instead of a blank slide.
A small wealth-management shop uses the Market Researcher agent to produce daily client-ready market briefs without hiring a dedicated research analyst.
An independent bookkeeping firm deploys the GL Reconciler agent to speed up month-end reconciliation for small-business clients, billing the time saved.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'deploy Claude's finance agents for your firm' setup and customization service for boutique banks and advisors.
Run a managed version for smaller advisory firms, charging monthly per seat with compliance review included.

steal_this: Package the Market Researcher agent as a done-for-you 'daily client brief' service for three local independent financial advisors who can't afford a research team — deliver the first week free, then charge monthly.
